blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Basilan Governor Mujiv Hataman called for unity and good governance following the installation of the first regular Bangsamoro Parliament and the election of Member of Parliament Abdulraof Macacua as chief minister. In a statement on Sunday, Hataman noted that government success must be measured by tangible improvements in the lives of ordinary citizens. He urged leaders across political divisions to shift their focus from political exercises to addressing the pressing socio-economic challenges confronting the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). “With the election of Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua and the organization of the Bangsamoro […]...
